name: DDM
rootCause: The official DeFi money market agreement DMM Twitter said that during $DMG public sale today, its telegram was unfortunately brigaded by malicious actors who impersonated the DMM Foundation with sole the intent of stealing funds. After digging through the on-chain transactions to find those affected, the official sent a total of $40k worth of DMG to those affected at an exchange rate of $0.40 per DMG, hoping to make sure everyone who lost funds were made whole.
